messages:
mira: Heads-up — we need to finalise the AWS marketplace listing this week. Items: hero image (1024x512), SKU mapping for trial vs paid, legal checkbox confirmations, and the listing short blurb. Who owns each?

alex: I can take SKU mapping. I'll build a tiny CSV and dump to the shared drive. Need to confirm taxation code for trials though.

jonah: I'll grab the hero image from product marketing. @laura do we have a final PNG in the brand folder? :camera_with_flash:

laura: there's an updated hero in `s3://redwood-marketing/marketplace/hero_v3.png` — approve copy is in the same folder as `hero_notes.md`. I'll attach alt text in a sec.

mira: perfect. alex — for SKU mapping can you follow the AWS bundle model? e.g. one SKU for "Redwood Hosted API - Trial" and one for "Redwood Hosted API - PayG". Keep SKUs stable for the publisher APIs.

alex: yep. sample mapping I'm going to use:```sku,plan_name,license_term,price_unit
RW-MKT-TRIAL,Hosted API - 30d Trial,trial,0
RW-MKT-PAYG,Hosted API - PayG,monthly,per_token
RW-MKT-DED,Hosted Dedicated - Monthly,commit,monthly```I'll push CSV to `partnerships/marketplace-assets/sku-mapping.csv`.

jonah: FYI legal reminded me to include the data processing addendum link and the EULA checkbox check. @mira can legal confirm the final clause? :eyes:

mira: pinging legal via DM now. We need confirmation that the short blurb doesn't promise SLA details — keep it high level.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: AWS listing requirement checklist updated — missing fields: "Pricing Model Details", "Support Contact Email", "Images (hero & logo)". Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/listing/checklist/abc123

alex: adding support email `marketplace-support@redwood.ai` to the CSV. Also tagging the tax team offline about VAT handling for EU customers.

laura: alt text for hero: "Redwood Inference platform dashboard visualizing latency and cost metrics". Short blurb draft: "Redwood Inference — predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Start with a 30-day trial." Thoughts?

jonah: sounds good. maybe change "Start with a 30-day trial" -> "Includes a 30-day trial" to avoid CTA that conflicts with marketplace rules.

laura: updated: "Includes a 30-day trial."

mira: legal update: @alex @jonah Legal approves the EULA and DPA links, but flagged that we must not use the term "SLA-backed" in the public blurb unless we attach the SLA doc for Dedicated offering. Keep hosted blurb generic.

alex: noted. I'll remove SLA phrasing. Also: do we want to bundle an "onboarding" SKU (one-time) for marketplace billing? Some customers prefer a single invoice for onboarding services.

jonah: yes — create `RW-MKT-ONB` one-time SKU for Professional Services onboarding. Price TBD, we'll leave price blank and mark as "contact us" in the listing (AWS supports that).

mira: quick check on images: need retina logo 512x512 and hero 1024x512. @laura can you export both and confirm they pass AWS guidelines (no promotional overlays like "20% off")?

laura: exporting now. will upload as `logo_512.png` and `hero_1024.png` in the s3 path.

marketplace-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-marketing/marketplace/hero_1024.png by laura at 1768732400

alex: CSV uploaded: `partnerships/marketplace-assets/sku-mapping.csv` (version v1) — includes onboarding SKU with blank price column.

mira: next steps: 1) @legal please send final EULA + DPA links in thread; 2) @alex finalize CSV with tax notes; 3) @laura confirm imagery file names; 4) I'll schedule content upload to AWS tomorrow morning. If anyone needs to change wording, speak up by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jonah: I'll run the short blurb through a quick compliance check and post any edits.

marketplace-bot: Checklist status: Images ✅, SKU CSV ✅, Pricing Model Details ✖️, Legal Links ✖️.

mira: thanks — team aligned. We'll aim to submit to AWS staging by Friday.

legal: Legal here — EULA https://legal.redwood.ai/eula-v2, DPA https://legal.redwood.ai/dpa-v1. Confirmed no SLA language in the hosted blurb. :white_check_mark:

alex: added legal links to the listing doc and updated CSV notes with tax flag `EU_VAT_APPLIES=true` for trial conversions.

laura: uploaded final assets and confirmed filenames in the spreadsheet.

mira: awesome. Last ask: @sam_k from growth — want any co-marketing copy for the listing homepage?

sam_k: happy to draft a short one-line value prop for the marketplace homepage. I'll post a suggestion in the morning. :rocket:

mira: great. Closing the loop here — if no objections by EOD we'll push to staging. Thanks all! :tada:
